_meta.indication: Somatuline Depot (lanreotide) Injection 60 mg, 90 mg and 120 mg is indicated for the long-term treatment of acromegalic patients who have had an inadequate response to surgery and/or radiotherapy, or for whom surgery and/or radiotherapy is not an option.
_meta.receipt_date: 10/30/2006 (Stamp Date 2006-10-30; NDA dated October 27, 2006, received October 30, 2006)

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.phase: Not explicitly phased; long-term, multiple-dose, randomized multicenter study
pivotal_trials.design: One-year study with a 4-week double-blind, placebo-controlled phase, a 16-week single-blind, fixed-dose phase, and a 32-week open-label dose-titration phase.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with active acromegaly based on biochemical tests and medical history; half (54/108) were somatostatin analog/dopamine agonist naive (or had stopped treatment for at least 3 months) and were required to have a mean GH level > 5 ng/mL at their first visit.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was the proportion of patients with a >50% reduction in mean GH from baseline to Week 4 after a single injection of drug or placebo.
pivotal_trials.n: 108 patients enrolled in the initial placebo-controlled phase (51 males, 57 females); placebo N=25, lanreotide overall N=83.
pivotal_trials.result: In the double-blind phase, 52 (63%) of 83 lanreotide-treated patients had a >50% decrease in mean GH from baseline to Week 4 (52%, 44%, 90% in 60, 90, 120 mg groups) vs 0% (0/25) placebo. In the fixed-dose phase at Week 16, 72% of 107 lanreotide-treated patients had a >50% decrease.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, uncontrolled with a 4-month fixed-dose phase (four Somatuline Depot 90 mg injections at 4-week intervals) followed by a dose-titration phase.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with an IGF-1 concentration ≥ 1.3 times the upper limit of the age-adjusted normal range.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Achievement of normal age-adjusted IGF-1 concentrations.
pivotal_trials.n: 63 patients (38 males, 25 females) entered the fixed-dose phase; 57 completed 48 weeks.
pivotal_trials.result: After 48 weeks, 43% (27/63) of patients achieved normal age-adjusted IGF-1 concentrations; at the end of treatment, 24/63 (38%) had both normal IGF-1 and GH ≤ 2.5 ng/mL.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>5% in overall pooled data, N=416) were gastrointestinal disorders — diarrhea (37%), abdominal pain (19%), nausea (11%) — cholelithiasis and injection site reactions. Cholelithiasis and gallbladder sludge were reported in 20% of patients.
target_moa: Lanreotide is a somatostatin analog with high affinity for human somatostatin receptors (SSTR) 2 and 5; activity at SSTR 2 and 5 is the primary mechanism believed responsible for GH inhibition.

rems.type: No specialized risk management activity is required based on the safety data.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held (Not applicable).

description.text: Added a new dosing regimen of every 6 to 8 weeks for the 120 mg strength for patients controlled on 60 mg or 90 mg

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes the addition of a new dosing regimen of every 6 to 8 weeks for the 120 mg strength for patients who are controlled on Somatuline Depot 60 mg or 90 mg in the Dosage and Administration section of the package insert.

description.text: Added new indication for treatment of unresectable, well- or moderately-differentiated, locally advanced or metastatic gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) to improve progression-free survival

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for the treatment of patients with unresectable, well- or moderately-differentiated, locally advanced or metastatic gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) to improve progression-free survival.

description.text: Added new indication for treatment of adults with carcinoid syndrome to reduce frequency of short-acting somatostatin analog rescue therapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for the treatment of adults with carcinoid syndrome; when used, it reduces the frequency of short-acting somatostatin analog rescue therapy.

orphan_indication.text: Acromegaly is an orphan indication and the drug has been designated as an orphan drug.

citations.quote: Acromegaly is an orphan indication and, indeed, this drug has been designated as an orphan drug. Amongst other things, this means PREA does not apply and hence there will be no deferrals or phase 4 commitments for pediatric studies.

summary.text: NDA 22-074 for Somatuline Depot (lanreotide) for long-term treatment of acromegaly received a priority designation and was granted orphan drug designation, with no advisory committee meeting, no required Phase 4 commitments and no required risk management activity.
